description: A sprint's own TIMELINE, oldest first: made, started, changed (name, goal, days), issues that came in and left ('direction' in/out on an issue's line), completed, deleted, restored, rolled back, and bulk moves. Each line is a journal line — 'type', 'field', 'from', 'to', 'issueKey', 'actor', 'createdAt' — with 'via' (the door: ui, api, mcp, agent, system) and, where a program did it, 'channel' { token: the token's name, client: the client it said it was, e.g. 'Claude' }; 'sprintChange' names a set of changes rollback_sprint_change undoes. Issues of projects you cannot open are only counted ('hidden'). A sprint in the board's trash is read too — by its id (list_sprint_trash lists them). Any member may read it.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board holds the sprint — needed only when 'sprint' is a name.

sprint.description: The sprint's id — from list_sprints, list_sprint_trash or a journal line. Or its name with projectKey.
